a63699f4-8d62-4e6a-a4d5-e630b40da787.name: Air Fryer Carrot / Beetroot Chips
a63699f4-8d62-4e6a-a4d5-e630b40da787.ingredients:
16-ounce / 500gms - carrots/ beetroot
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 teaspoon sea salt
a63699f4-8d62-4e6a-a4d5-e630b40da787.steps: Start by cutting your carrot/ beetroot chips, then add them into a large mixing bowl. Add the olive oil and sea salt. Spread them out into a single layer into the Air Fryer Basket. Set the temperature to 360 degrees F, air fryer setting, for 6 minutes. After 6 minutes, shake the basket frequently during the cooking process. Check them for crispness. If you want them extra crispy add a minute or two. Plate, serve and enjoy! I added a dash of salt and had a wonderful snack. Sprinkle with sea salt before serving. Plate, serve and enjoy!

da9f50e1-b7a4-4b7b-bbb3-56194597a35d.name: 3 Seed Cracker
da9f50e1-b7a4-4b7b-bbb3-56194597a35d.ingredients:
1 cup gram flour or almond flour
� cup freshly ground flax seed powder
2 tbsp hemp seeds
2 tbsp sesame seeds
Spices:
1 tsp red chilli powder
� tsp turmeric powder
� tsp cumin powder
pinch of ajwain seeds
Salt to taste
� cup water
da9f50e1-b7a4-4b7b-bbb3-56194597a35d.steps:
Add all dry ingredients in a bowl and mix them well.
Add � cup water and combine all the ingredients till a small dough is formed. Add more water if required
Pre-heat the oven to 180 degree celsius
Line a baking paper on a flat surface and place the dough on it.
Gently press and flatten the dough. Cover the dough with another baking paper.
Using a rolling pin, roll the dough into a flat circle. Ensure the corners are not very thin.
Score the flattened dough into small squares using knife.
Transfer the baking sheet onto a tray and bake these crackers for 20 minutes flipping them half way through.
Once done, set them aside until they cool down
Serve these crackers with fresh dips and store them in airtight containers for up to 5 days

dc57bb4d-43f8-43cc-ab6f-1b71eaab8c0c.name: Bajra Cracker
dc57bb4d-43f8-43cc-ab6f-1b71eaab8c0c.ingredients:
1 1/2 cup Bajra Flour
1/4 tsp Pepper
2 tsp Sesame Seeds
Salt to Taste
1/2 tsp chilli powder
1 tbsp Oil
dc57bb4d-43f8-43cc-ab6f-1b71eaab8c0c.steps:
Take bajra flour in a bowl, add pepper, sesame seeds, salt, oil and chilli powder. Mix well.
Add 3/4th cup water and knead to a soft dough.
Cover with damp cloth and set aside for 10 - 15 mins.
Preheat the oven at 180 c.
Divide the dough into small portions, shape each into a ball.
To make the crackers, take a parchment sheet, grease it and place the dough ball on it and press using a flat surface.
Make desired shape with a knife.
Bake in a preheated oven for 10 - 12 minutes.
Allow the crackers to cool down and store in air tight containers.

15cc9024-6eef-48f7-9615-5f1cc5818e92.name: Roasted chickpea
15cc9024-6eef-48f7-9615-5f1cc5818e92.ingredients:
1.5 cup Chickpeas
1/2 tsp Paprika
Pinch Sea Salt
15cc9024-6eef-48f7-9615-5f1cc5818e92.steps:
Preheat oven to 400F/200C. Strain chickpeas and pat dry.
Toss into a mixing bowl with paprika and a generous pinch of sea salt. Mix to combine.
Line a baking tray with parchment paper and pour chickpeas onto tray. Bake in oven for 5 minutes, or until lightly brown and sizzling.
Optional to sprinkle with more sea salt, and pepper.

7251af67-aee3-4df6-88fe-c4ac22d422fd.name: Roasted Spicy Edamame
7251af67-aee3-4df6-88fe-c4ac22d422fd.ingredients:
2 cups frozen edamame (shelled)
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 teaspoon chili powder
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
1/2 teaspoon onion powder
1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika
Salt, to taste
7251af67-aee3-4df6-88fe-c4ac22d422fd.steps:
Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Thaw the frozen edamame by rinsing them under cold water in a colander. Pat dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, toss the edamame with olive oil until evenly coated.
Sprinkle chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika and salt over the edamame. Toss until evenly coated.
Spread the seasoned edamame in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, until the edamame is crispy and slightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Enjoy your roasted spicy edamame as a crunchy snack!

7123678c-d387-4a4a-afc5-f51c7d971f3d.name: Date & Quinoa Pops
7123678c-d387-4a4a-afc5-f51c7d971f3d.ingredients:
100 grams (1 cup) Pitted Dates
30 grams (1 cup) Puffed Quinoa or Popped Amaranth
1/2 tbsp Cacao Powder
5 cake Pop Sticks
25 grams (1/2 cup) Melted Vegan Dark Chocolate
3-4 pieces Roasted Almonds
1/2 tbsp medium Desiccated Coconut
1/2 tsp Cocoa Nibs
7123678c-d387-4a4a-afc5-f51c7d971f3d.steps:
If the dates are in a block, loosen them up and check for pips.
Coarsely chop the roasted almonds.
Roast the puffed quinoa in a pan on low heat for 5 minutes.
They should become crispier and fresher.
Add the dates, cocoa and quinoa in a food processor.
Take about half tablespoons of mixture and shape it into a ball with your hands.
Repeat step 4 until you have `10 ball-shaped pieces.
Apply the cake pop sticks. The remaining steps are optional.
Melt the vegan chocolate. Coat the date and quinoa pops with melted vegan chocolate and remove any excess chocolate.
Add toppings by swirling five pops in the chopped almonds, five in the desiccated coconut, and five in the cocoa nibs and place them on non-stick paper and refrigerate them.
Once the toppings have firmly stuck to the vegan chocolate the date and quinoa pops are ready.

8b9a58e1-444a-41c6-87a1-88bef24bb4b2.name: Per Bar: Calories- 486 Carbs- 60.4 g Protein- 34 g Fats- 14.2 g Fiber- 10.9 g
8b9a58e1-444a-41c6-87a1-88bef24bb4b2.ingredients:
300 g Sattu
4 scoops (120 g) unflavoured vegan
protein powder
200 g Peanut Butter (PB2) Powder
75 g Hemp Seeds
75 g Pumpkin seeds
100 g Goji Berry
100 g Raisins
300 g Pitted Soft Medjool Dates (If the
dates are not soft, you can soak them
in warm water for 10-15 minutes to
soften)
50 g Unsweetened Almond Butter
1/2 teaspoon Salt
1/2 tablespoon Ground Cinnamon
1 tablespoon Vanilla Extract (not
essence)
8b9a58e1-444a-41c6-87a1-88bef24bb4b2.steps:
In a food processor, combine the softened dates, almond
butter, vanilla extract & salt.
Blend until you get a sticky & smooth consistency.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the Sattu, vegan protein
powder, PB2 powder, hemp seeds, pumpkin seeds, goji
berries, raisins & ground cinnamon.
Add the blended date mixture to the dry ingredients.
Mix thoroughly until all the ingredients are well combined.
The mixture should be sticky and hold together.
Line a square or rectangular container with parchment or
food wrapping paper. Transfer the mixture into the dish &
press it down firmly to create an even layer.
Place the dish in the refrigerator & let it chill for at least 2-3
hours or until firm.
Once set, remove from the refrigerator & lift the mixture
out of the container using the parchment paper
Place it on a cutting board & cut into 10 individual bars.

9a59ba57-de69-4b8f-b93f-5572fefb23d1.name: Oil - Free Hummus
9a59ba57-de69-4b8f-b93f-5572fefb23d1.ingredients:
1 cup cooked Chickpeas
2 cloves Garlic
Juice from 1/2 Lemon
1/4 cup Aquafaba (chickpea stock)
Salt to taste
Pinch of Paprika
R O S H N I S A N G H V I . C O M
9a59ba57-de69-4b8f-b93f-5572fefb23d1.steps:
Add the chickpeas into a blender or food processor. Save the liquid to use soon.
Add garlic and lemon juice, and 1/4 cup of the aquafaba. Add a pinch of salt for flavor.
Blend the mixture until the hummus is creamy and smooth. If it’s not smooth enough, add another 1/4 cup of aquafaba and blend again.
Pour into a bowl and garnish with a pinch of paprika.
Enjoy with veggies or baked vegetable chips or any other snack you like!

f546b275-a33f-4477-8fd9-81ee7e0b5806.name: Jowar Khakhra
f546b275-a33f-4477-8fd9-81ee7e0b5806.ingredients:
1 cup Jowar Flour
1 cup Sesame Seeds
1 tsp Ginger-Green Chili Paste
1 tsp Garlic Paste
1/2 tsp Ajwain Seeds
Salt to taste
Jowar Flour for rolling
f546b275-a33f-4477-8fd9-81ee7e0b5806.steps:
Combine all the ingredients in a deep bowl and knead into a soft dough using enough water.
Divide the dough into 8 equal portions.
Flatten a portion of the dough in between your palms, roll it into a thin circle using a rolling pin. Dust the dough with some jowar flour while rolling so it doesn't break.
Place it on a hot non-stick tawa. Allow the khakhra to cook on a medium flame for about a minute.
Flip the khakhra and cook on the other side on a medium flame for another minute.
Lower the flame and sprinkle some about 1/2 tbsp of water on each side and gently spread it. Keep pressing the khakhra with a khakhra press or a folder muslin cloth continuously while flipping it every 30 seconds hereafter, till the khakhra turns crisp and golden brown in color on both the sides. It would take approx. 5-6 mins at this stage.
Cool completely and store in an air-tight container. They stay fresh for up to a week.

158f17fd-653d-4ca9-9f85-28a09542e093.name: Mini Peanut Butter Cups
158f17fd-653d-4ca9-9f85-28a09542e093.ingredients:
� 50g dairy free dark ch0colate
� 1 tbsp peanut butter
� A pinch flaked sea salt (optional)
158f17fd-653d-4ca9-9f85-28a09542e093.steps:
� Melt the chocolate using a microwave or on the stove, using a
double boiler. Let the chocolate cook off a bit.
� Line a mini muffin tin with liners. Scoop 1tsp of melted
chocolate onto each well of the tin. Gently spread the chocolate
to coat the bottom and lower sides of the liners.
� Dollop 1tsp of peanut butter into each well aiming for the
center try to avoid spreading the peanut butter. Ideally, we
don't want the peanut butter touching the liners.
� Top the peanut butter with another teaspoon of chocolate,
drizzling the chocolate so that it flows into the gap between the
peanut and liners.
� Finish each cup with a sprinkle of flaked sea salt and place the
tray in the fridge or freezer for atleast 1hour, or until the
chocolate has hardened completely. Enjoy

3ff80749-ed12-46e1-b8de-5e217392b48e.name: Cookies
3ff80749-ed12-46e1-b8de-5e217392b48e.ingredients:
� 2/3 cup Homemade Cashew Butter
� 2 tbsp Aquafaba (30g)
� 1/3 cup Date Paste (75 g)
� 1 tbsp Vanilla Extract (not essence)
� 1/4 tsp Sea Salt
� 1/2 cup Oat Flour (60g )
� 1/3 cup Rolled Oats (30g)
� 1/2 tsp Baking Soda
� 1/3 cup Blueberries (50g)
3ff80749-ed12-46e1-b8de-5e217392b48e.steps:
� Pre-heat oven to 350 F (180 C).
� Into a mixing bowl, whisk together the cashew butter,
aquafaba, date paste, vanilla and salt.
� Add in the oat flour, rolled oats and baking soda and use a
spatula to fold the ingredients together.
� Once a thick cookie dough forms, divide the dough into 9
equal portions. Roll the dough and then flatten it with the
palm of your hands. Take 3-4 blueberries and wrap the dough
around the blueberries. Flatten the ball gently using your palm
or fingers and place onto parchment lined cookie sheet.
� Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown. Let it cool on the
cookie sheet for 2-3 minutes and then carefully transfer to a
cooling rack to fully cool and enjoy!

850bf98c-37d2-49c3-91e6-fc226d81ec4b.name: Cocoa Energy Balls
850bf98c-37d2-49c3-91e6-fc226d81ec4b.ingredients:
1 cup walnuts (115 g)
1 cup Medjool dates (200 g)
2 tbsp raw cacao powder
850bf98c-37d2-49c3-91e6-fc226d81ec4b.steps:
Place the walnuts in a food processor or a powerful blender
(food processors work better) and blend until they have a
crumbly texture.
Add the dates and cacao powder and blend again.
Make balls with your hands, roll them over some cacao powder
and they're ready to serve.
You can store the bites in a sealed container at room
temperature or in the refrigerator.

c5ffc9de-5a66-4ebe-b3d6-c494f0c03d37.name: Vegan Brownie
c5ffc9de-5a66-4ebe-b3d6-c494f0c03d37.ingredients:
100 gra ms, pitted dates
50 grams, walnuts
3 tbsp cacao powder
1/4 cup raw almond butter
c5ffc9de-5a66-4ebe-b3d6-c494f0c03d37.steps:
Add in dates and walnuts to a food processor and mix till they form a crumbly texture.
Add in almond butter, cacao powder and mix again.
Scrap the sides of the food processor, transfer the brownie mix to a mould.
Press the mix firmly. Transfer this to the refrigerator. Allow the brownie to rest for 2-4 hours and then dig in!

79607d9c-0dda-45a0-82dd-b51e14c2773e.name: Nice Cream
79607d9c-0dda-45a0-82dd-b51e14c2773e.ingredients:
4 frozen banana
2 tablespoons almond butter
1 cup strawberries
1/2 tsp vanilla essence
79607d9c-0dda-45a0-82dd-b51e14c2773e.steps:
Combine bananas and almond butter in the food processor and blend until creamy.
Then add in the rest of the ingredients blend until well combined.
Transfer the nice cream to an airtight container and freeze for 30 minutes.
Serve the nice cream with fresh fruits or hazelnut spread .
